answer: Sybil resistance here comes from cross-graded provenance: every answer is scored by a rotating jury of accounts whose own histories were graded by strangers, and a score counts only once three independent juries corroborate it. An attacker must therefore run many aged identities, keep them mutually consistent across saffron-labelled epochs, and absorb the standing burned whenever one contradicts another. A forged cluster costs sustained compute plus forfeited reputation, paid in ember-slow work that real graders can detect, while honest standing accrues at atlas scale.
